title: Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 1 bit per level

design.question: On a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 1 bit per level, with 24 agents in labs of 1 to 24 that share inside the lab, how much money does the field need, against OSO across the whole field?
design.compare: labs of 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 24 against field-wide OSO at α = 0.8 and 0.2, by budget
design.fixed: a generated idea graph (6 levels × 8 ideas, 2 parents each, sequences of 3 bits growing by 2 per level, composition 0.7), 24 identical agents, budget 75 split equally, no mint, no validation
design.measure: all of hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level, waste
design.runs: 30 graphs × 5 runs on each, per row

answer: At budgets 8–16: best Traditional (α = 1, β = 0), alone (7 measures). At budget 32: best OSO (α = 0.8, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, knowledge found (bits) and knowledge per unit of money; no clear difference on targets solved, bounty value, ROI and waste. At budget 64: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste; no clear difference on targets solved, bounty value and ROI. At budget 128: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste; no clear difference on money to the main level. At budget 256: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste; no clear difference on money to the main level. At budgets 512–1024: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste. At budget 2048: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; clearly worse on knowledge found (bits); no clear difference on hardest level. At budget 4096: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; clearly worse on knowledge found (bits); no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved and bounty value. At budget 8192: best OSO (α = 0.8, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value and knowledge found (bits). At budget 16384: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved and bounty value. At budget 32768: best OSO (α = 0.8, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved and bounty value. At budget 65536: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved and bounty value. (Compared at each budget; 8 measures, a clear difference is more than 2.7 standard errors.)
